notes_for_editor: Only one page was usable (Forest Lookouts), quoting a 1937-38 state report and an NGS data sheet. No build date, height, staffing or condition was found. The record's height_m of 6.1 has no supporting source among the pages read; left unchanged, not entered as a fact. Status stays unknown. Two searches returned only map listings (anyplaceamerica, topozone) that give a name and coordinates, no history. A check of the 1937-38 report or Michigan archives would be the next step.
